_how_to_fill: Keys must match folder names (train_data/<model>, gallery/<model>/<colorway>). Fill sku, release_date (YYYY-MM-DD), retail_price_usd and source (the URL you verified it on). Leave a fact null if you can't verify it; the app shows 'Not verified'.

air_jordan_1.name: Air Jordan 1
air_jordan_1.description: Michael Jordan's first signature shoe, introduced in 1985.

air_jordan_4.name: Air Jordan 4
air_jordan_4.description: Designed by Tinker Hatfield and released in 1989, known for its mesh panels and 'wings'.

nike_dunk_low.name: Nike Dunk Low
nike_dunk_low.description: Originally a 1985 college basketball shoe, now one of Nike's most popular lifestyle sneakers.

nike_sb_dunk.name: Nike SB Dunk
nike_sb_dunk.description: The skateboarding version of the Dunk, launched under Nike SB in 2002, with a padded tongue and Zoom Air insole.

nike_air_force_1.name: Nike Air Force 1
nike_air_force_1.description: Introduced in 1982 as the first basketball shoe with Nike Air cushioning.

yeezy_boost_350.name: Adidas Yeezy Boost 350
yeezy_boost_350.description: Low-top Yeezy model with a Primeknit upper and Boost midsole, first released in 2015.

adidas_samba.name: Adidas Samba
adidas_samba.description: Created as an indoor soccer shoe around 1950 and now a lifestyle staple, recognizable by its T-toe and gum sole.

new_balance_550.name: New Balance 550
new_balance_550.description: A 1989 basketball shoe revived in 2020 that became a lifestyle favorite.

new_balance_9060.name: New Balance 9060
new_balance_9060.description: A chunky lifestyle runner from the 2020s inspired by New Balance's 99X series.

asics_gel_kayano.name: ASICS Gel-Kayano
asics_gel_kayano.description: ASICS' long-running stability running line, first released in 1993; retro versions like the Gel-Kayano 14 are popular lifestyle picks.
